page.notes: Greek index entries in the left column (lines after "Antichristi", "Antiochena" and "Apostata") are printed in small Greek type and could not be read reliably; they are marked illegible rather than guessed. Some Greek and italic words in the third column ("Arrhabo" region, "Artibus" region) are similarly unreadable. Section letter "B" is printed as a separate large initial; its entries begin with the joined initial. Entries marked illegible in the left and right columns are the Greek or italic words at the start of the line; their page references are copied as printed.
